notes: Hidalgo County, Texas (not Hidalgo County, New Mexico; NM SOS results pages appeared in results and were ignored). Results are posted as static documents on the county CivicPlus site: per-election pages (hidalgocounty.us/3477/May-26-2026-Primary-Runoff-Election, hidalgocounty.us/3456/49276/2026-Joint-Primary-Election) and a DocumentCenter item titled 'Count_HtmlCumulativeReport' (HTML-Cumulative-Results-24GENERAL). Platform set to county_pdfs as the closest category for static result documents on the county domain; note the visible 24GENERAL item is an HTML export, not a .pdf. LEADS only (search summaries): 'Precinct by precinct reports are available' and Democratic runoff results 'by precinct (PCT by PCT)'; unofficial final runoff results linked from the department Facebook page. None says when precinct reports were posted relative to election night. Phone 956-318-2570 / (956) 318-2570 appeared only in search summaries (email redacted), not attributed verbatim to a county page title or quote, so left empty; county staff directory page exists at hidalgocounty.us/Directory/Home/DepartmentListing?DID=64. No 2025/2026 statement about changing precinct-level reporting found. No usage notice seen verbatim. Fetch module: 1 direct attempt plus wayback_probe (3 CDX windows) on hidalgocounty.us/DocumentCenter/View/, all robots_disallowed_or_unreachable. WebFetch not attempted (all earlier WebFetch attempts on county and news hosts returned EGRESS_BLOCKED).
tag_rationale: Precinct-by-precinct reports exist on the county site, but no source states when they were posted on election night for any target election. Tag UNKNOWN.
